findings.evidence: Question requests route distance, but SQL takes aircraft range rather than a distance between airport coordinates.
findings.label: wrong_measure

findings.evidence: SQL is a constant zero count without city pairs, distance computation, or buckets.
findings.label: question_not_implemented

findings.evidence: SQL nests SUM window evaluation inside LAG; saved SQLite outcome reports misuse of window function SUM().
findings.label: window_function_misuse

findings.evidence: ROW_NUMBER operates on city records without first choosing exactly one record per date; duplicate dates can change consecutive-day groups.
findings.label: grain

findings.evidence: Consecutive-day detection uses city rows without DISTINCT country/date before LAG, so repeated dates can break groups.
findings.label: grain

findings.evidence: Month-day tests on term endpoints do not establish whether a multi-year interval contains December 31.
findings.label: date_logic

findings.evidence: Retention probes an anniversary minus one day rather than December 31; saved execution also hit its resource limit.
findings.label: date_logic

findings.evidence: SUM over per-race standings may accumulate already cumulative season totals; requires source-value verification, not asserted as proven.
findings.label: aggregation

findings.evidence: SQL minimizes constructor-season totals; question asks about drivers with the fewest positive season points and then their constructors.
findings.label: grain

findings.evidence: Pit-stop join uses race and driver without lap, multiplying lap rows for drivers with multiple stops; subsequent CASE does not remove those rows.
findings.label: join_fanout

findings.evidence: Output returns drive segments and does not explicitly compare constructors at a driver-season first and last participating races.
findings.label: entity_identity

findings.evidence: LAG is partitioned by driver only, omitting race_id, so consecutive observations can cross races.
findings.label: entity_identity

findings.evidence: The SQL excludes pit stops and lap one but never excludes retirements requested by the question.
findings.label: population_filter

method: Manual inspection of saved development B6R questions, SQL, and execution outcomes. No new model calls or query executions.
